blocks.content: Before you explore your services, make sure you have a Pyroscope data source, then open Profiles Drilldown and focus on the signal that matters.

This journey uses a Grafana Pyroscope data source named `grafanacloud-play-profiles` that connects to the public play Pyroscope instance. The next step checks whether you already have it and helps you add it if you don't.

blocks.description: Create the grafanacloud-play-profiles Pyroscope data source when it is missing.

whenTrue.content: You already have the **grafanacloud-play-profiles** data source. You'll select it in the next step.

whenFalseSectionConfig.title: Add the play Pyroscope data source

whenFalse.content: You don't have the **grafanacloud-play-profiles** data source yet. Create it with the following steps.
Open **Connections > Data sources > Add new data source**.
Select **Grafana Pyroscope** from the list of data source types.

whenFalse.reftarget: [data-testid='data-testid Data source settings page name input field']
whenFalse.content: At the top of the page, rename the data source to `grafanacloud-play-profiles`.
Click **Save & test**. You should see a message confirming the data source is working.

blocks.content:
With the data source in place, open Profiles Drilldown and choose it.

To explore your services, complete the following steps:
In the navigation menu, expand **Drilldown** if it is collapsed. If it is already expanded, skip this step.

Select **grafanacloud-play-profiles** as the **Data source**.

The **All services** view shows a chart for each service. This step also sets the Quick filter to `checkout` so `checkoutservice` is on screen.

Make sure the **CPU** profile type (`process_cpu/cpu`) is selected.

We will be taking a look at `checkoutservice`.
Optional detour: before you look into labels, open **Profile types** for `checkoutservice` to see graphs for each profile type.

blocks.reftarget: section[data-testid='data-testid Panel header checkoutservice'] button[aria-label='Profile types']

blocks.content: The **Profile types** tab shows each profile type available for `checkoutservice`. Each panel has **Labels** and **Flame graph** shortcuts.
Return to the **All services** view to continue. If you're already there, click **Skip**.
